title: DCGAN Throughput Benchmark: 32x32 RGB (B=16, W=64)
intuition: Measures synchronized per-update wall time (ms/step), throughput (images/s), and peak GPU memory for one complete public trainer step on 32x32 RGB DCGAN mock data (3 warmup + 10 measured updates).
failure_mode: Excessive host-device synchronizations or per-step Python/SVD overhead inflate small-image latency well above the convolutional backbone baseline.
protocol_notes: Separate research_diagnostic throughput workload on Uniform[-1,1] mock RGB data; confers zero image-quality or qualification credit.
